ITA-5.71.10 śakunīgrahaḥ शकुनीग्रहः
Symptom complex resembling bacterial infection of the skin due to external invisible factors
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a smell of birds emanating from the body; generalized discharging lesions; flaccidity/laxity; blisters with burning sensation spread over body; blisters with suppuration spread over body; afflicted with skin lesions due to injuries or trauma; diarrhoea; tongue ulcer; palate ulcer; throat ulcer; repeated blisters on joints; manifesting at any time; stomatitis; proctitis; fever; smelling of shakuni (a type of bird).

ITA-3.7.1 gudam, pāyuḥ,bradhnaḥ,mahatsrotaḥ, śakṛnmārgaḥ गुदम्, पायुः, ब्रध्नः, महत्स्रोतः, शकृन्मार्गः
Anus

ITA-8.2.5 śākavargaḥ शाकवर्गः
Group of vegetables
The group of vegetables comprising leaf, root or tuber, flower, stem and fruit.

ITA-2.8.22 śākunikāyaḥ शाकुनिकायः
Person with intolerant, The characteristics of the person with an intolerant, unsteady unsteady temperament temperament are overindulgence in sexual activity, incessant eating, intolerance or impatience, and unsteadiness of mind.

ITA-8.3.28 saktuḥ सक्तुः
Toasted grain flour
A dietetic preparation made by adding sugar and water to the flour of roasted grains such as barley, wheat, Bengal gram or parched rice.

ITA-3.16.6 Sakthimarma सक्थिमर्म
Vulnerable location(s) in the lower limbs
Marma located in the lower limbs.

ITA-1.9.3.2.6 sākṣī साक्षी
Witness of all actions
The soul (atma) not actively participating in any action but performing the duty of a witness.
